subject: [PATCH 04/11] nfsd: don't grant write delegations to NFSv4.0 clients on CLAIM_PREVIOUS

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch prevents NFSv4.0 clients from receiving write delegations when reclaiming a file during the grace period. The issue arises because the current implementation allows write delegations on CLAIM_PREVIOUS, but this can lead to inconsistencies if the client sends a GETATTR request before returning the delegation. To fix this, the patch adds a check for NFSv4.0 clients attempting to reclaim a write open during the grace period and denies them write delegations.
